versions.content: The function shall put the indexed transceiver in the specified mode according to the following specified requirements. Each time a new mode is en- tered which was previously requested by EthTrcv_SetTransceiverMode, EthTrcv shall call EthIf_TrcvModeIndication latest during the next EthTrcv_MainFunction.
